summary: Felucca 1.5.1 with an extra "OPX" altered-FM engine modelled on the Korg opsix's operator section. A separate "OPX Solo" build runs only that engine, with more effects and presets.
features: Six operators per voice, up to six voices; 40 algorithms plus a user matrix
Operator modes: FM, ring mod, filter, filter FM, wave folder, effect
23 waveforms, per-operator envelopes and key tracking, 3 EGs and 3 LFOs
8 factory OPX sounds, 126 in OPX Solo; web editor with an OPX tab
All of Felucca 1.5.1 kept; its projects move both ways
No opsix arpeggiator or sequencer; user sample slot 3 halved

headings: if the fm-1 does not start
